title: GeoProvenance: automatic provenance capture and reproducibility auditing for QGIS Processing workflows
description: GeoProvenance is a QGIS plugin that automatically records QGIS Processing executions, stores them in SQLite mapped to the W3C PROV-O model, fingerprints input and output datasets (SHA-256 plus structural fingerprints that distinguish re-saves from real changes), draws the workflow as a provenance graph, and scores how reproducible the workflow still is. It uses only the Python standard library and PyQGIS.
